def store(auth_session)
  shop = find_or_initialize_by(shopify_domain: auth_session.shop)

changes.note: `Session#serialize` was removed. Applications must store individual session attributes rather than a serialized blob. The guide’s own "New implementation" heading carries no code block; this `after` is taken from the shopify_app reference implementation shown later in the same document.

`Session.deserialize` was removed due to a security vulnerability: it called Oj.load without safe mode, allowing instantiation of arbitrary Ruby objects. Sessions are reconstructed with Session.new() from stored attributes.
